title: A wide Markdown table's motion (user 2026-11-08: "this table thing needs better animation on appear/disappear"): in the Markdown viewer and in a chat reply, light then dark, every display frame recorded (debug.window_record into launch/strip-NN) while the table scrolls right and back and while a reply's table arrives. Shows the edge fades and the sideways thumb coming and going. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/markdown-table-motion.json --mac (any commit: the state is read from this file).

steps.title: Launch
Motion on, whatever the host's Reduce Motion says (the scene records motion)
A fixed window size, so every capture frames the table the same
A workspace for the Markdown viewer
Show it
Write a Markdown file with a table wider than the pane
cmux:
printf 'Retried rows by area, last 24 hours:

| Area | File | Owner | State | Opened | Rows | p50 | p99 | Retries | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sidebar | webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/sidebar/SidebarRowSnapshotList.tsx | Leo | open | Nov 3 | 4,120 | 12 ms | 88 ms | 3 | rows re-render on every typed key in the composer |
| Markdown | webviews/src/pages/markdown/tables.ts | Ana | fixed | Nov 5 | 980 | 8 ms | 41 ms | 0 | a wide table was cut hard at the right edge |
| Terminal | cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/scrollback/restore_journal.rs | Sam | review | Nov 6 | 15,300 | 3 ms | 19 ms | 1 | scrollback restore drops the last prompt line |
| Chat | webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/RevealedMarkdown.tsx | Kim | open | Nov 7 | 2,240 | 21 ms | 130 ms | 5 | streamed replies reflow the row under them |
' > /tmp/cmux-table-motion.md && echo cmux-table-$((1+1))-written

steps.title: The file is written (the shell printed the marker after the write): a fresh terminal's shell can start after any fixed wait, and the viewer then opened a missing file and stayed blank
Open it in the Markdown viewer, in front of the terminal
The table is drawn
A workspace for the chat
Show it
A new agent chat
light: appearance
light: the Markdown viewer
light: the table at its start
Record every frame (light viewer, scroll right)
light viewer: scroll to the last column (the left edge fade comes in, the right one goes)
Record every frame (light viewer, scroll back)
light viewer: scroll back to the start (the left fade goes, the right one comes back)
light: the chat
light: a fresh chat on the fake harness
Record every frame (light chat, the table appears)
light chat: a reply with a wide table arrives (the fake agent echoes the prompt)
